diagnosis: The loan credit risk evaluation polling endpoint retrieves and clears results from the in-memory EVALUATION_RESULTS dictionary by task_token. It fails to verify that result["applicant_id"] == current_user.id, allowing an authenticated applicant to pop and inspect credit scores, bank account debt ratios, and risk assessments of other applicants.
exploit_request:
GET /credit-evaluations/poll-result/tok_eval_8819203 HTTP/1.1
Host: loans.creditengine.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
